content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-my-unfiltered-take|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-15|Automated Ebook]]-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-16|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets online without relying on traditional payment processors is crucial for creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. These creators often find themselves locked out by platforms that impose high fees and restrictive policies. By utilizing crypto payment solutions like NOWPayments, creators can sell their work directly, retaining more of their earnings while also gaining the flexibility and sovereignty that conventional platforms lack.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure needed to sell design assets seamlessly includes several components, each chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness. For example, hosting can be achieved for free through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic can be managed with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Payment processing is handled efficiently by NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, compared to platforms like Gumroad that take a hefty 10%. This architecture ensures that the creator retains complete control and ownership of their digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who produce ebooks, courses, templates, and more. It empowers those in regions with limited access to payment platforms to monetize their work effectively. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can focus on their craft while confidently selling their products without worrying about steep fees or payment rejections. The model is built for those who want to take charge of their financial landscape.
Cut your sales fees from 10% to 0.5% with crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this digital commerce stack include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing via NOWPayments. Together, these tools create a robust ecosystem for creators to sell their work. The deployment process is straightforward, and once set up, the system operates autonomously, delivering products instantly upon payment confirmation. This integrated approach minimizes friction and maximizes revenue potential.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital commerce stack, start by selecting your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments and set up your product listings. Ensure your delivery mechanism is in place using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test the system to confirm that everything works seamlessly before launching.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Own your entire digital commerce stack without platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
